scope: Requested four-hour continuation: portable NumPy/raster runtime throughput, bounded large-artifact hashing and cancellation-safe backend cleanup; no new robot-policy quality or GPU throughput claim
changes: NumPy integration: full slices for all-active rows, early return for all-frozen rows, and one ascending ID extraction for partial masks; preserve scalar substep order, snapshot ownership and malformed-mask rejection behavior

Raster: restrict small-disk distance tests to conservatively expanded pixel rectangles for large workloads; keep the dense path for small workloads/large disks; use np.take for exact RGB palette copies

Environment cleanup: close both backends through KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit, retain cleanup diagnostics, preserve a primary operation/context/build error, and propagate cancellation on explicit close
Stream SHA-256 for ACT resume weight identity, native H1 checkpoint publication/model identity, and Wuji accepted-video identity; retain full byte reads used for hash+deserialization verification
Add a reproducible reference physics/environment benchmark and exact numerical/pixel, invalid-mask, cleanup-cancellation and bounded-allocation regression coverage

rgb_only_allocation.scope: RGB-only single raster frame, five repetitions; source trees fixed, outputs must match; measures traced allocation only, no timing/RSS claim. This checks channel-specific tradeoffs independently of four-channel benchmarks.
rgb_only_allocation.finding: Final large RGB-only raster probes use approximately 14.3% less peak traced allocation than the start-of-round source; promoting labels and releasing the original before RGB allocation removes the earlier overlap regression. Neither describes total process RSS.

large_artifact_hashing.scope: Hash phase only: original read_bytes/SHA256 expression vs bounded file_sha256; synthetic sparse binary files, fixed zeros; five alternating pairs. Traced Python allocation peak is not process RSS; concurrent correctness workloads make timings unsuitable for throughput claims. No Torch/ffprobe/SDK loading measured.

training_equivalence.scope: Final frozen candidate-release versus start-of-round baseline; reuse each completed baseline 3000-update run, then train candidate-release independently. Two tasks x three policy seeds, five fixed 128-episode evaluation seeds per trained model. Full metric stream, final model/Adam/Torch-RNG hashes and evaluation results must match exactly. Concurrent correctness stress and documented pauses make elapsed times unsuitable for speed claims.

accepted_source_applicability.training_and_evaluation_scope: All six 3000-update trained reference runs and their fixed-seed evaluations use render=null and no sensor channels; RGB-only renderer allocation changes are not executed. All policy/optimizer/task/physics/env/checkpoint code is byte-identical.

endurance.scope: Frozen candidate-accepted source; repeated actual NumPy/raster acquisition with 32/64/128/257 RGB-only and RGB+depth, both episode formats and workers 0/1/2, decoded and owned ordered/shuffled batch checksums equal per group; shared 1.25x legacy episode payload budget; injected archive/marker, worker interruption, final manifest retry and backend cleanup cancellation faults; raster differential against start-of-round source across sizes 32..540, radii 1e-12..4 and N1..64; physics exact comparison across masks/resets/masses/N1..1024. Temporary datasets removed and GC sampled each group; no RSS hard bound or performance timing claim.

earlier_runtime_endurance.note: Longer pre-RGB-only lifetime adjustment cohort; its executed physics, recorder, reader, and multi-channel raster paths are unchanged in the accepted source. Final RGB-only code is covered by the accepted cohort, full suites and channel benchmarks.

summary.scope: Frozen candidate-release source; repeated actual NumPy/raster acquisition with 32/64/128/257 RGB+depth, both episode formats and workers 0/1/2, decoded and owned ordered/shuffled batch checksums equal per group; shared 1.25x legacy episode payload budget; injected archive/marker, worker interruption, final manifest retry and backend cleanup cancellation faults; raster differential against start-of-round source across sizes 32..540, radii 1e-12..4 and N1..64; physics exact comparison across masks/resets/masses/N1..1024. Temporary datasets removed and GC sampled each group; no RSS hard bound or performance timing claim.

limitations: Reference planar CPU tasks, raster cameras and acquisition probes do not measure general articulated-robot rendering, GPU training or hardware execution.
Small gains and median paired ratios describe these inputs on this shared host; external machine activity remains uncontrolled.
Tracemalloc includes Python/NumPy allocations during each measured phase, not total process RSS. Hash memory gains do not establish whole-training memory savings.

The early np.take-only RGB probe increased peak traced allocation. The final accepted RGB-only lifetime adjustment removes that regression; channel-specific allocation results remain phase measurements, not total process RSS.
Large-radius/small-workload disks use the original dense geometry path. Returned image arrays and IDs/dtypes stay unchanged.

PPO training was measured on the pre-RGB-only adjustment snapshot; all training/task/physics/env/checkpoint source is byte-identical and the used NullRenderer AST is identical in the accepted source, with render=null/no channels proved for each run.
PPO equivalence is for two reference tasks and three policy seeds with fixed settings; environment and RNG resume semantics remain policy+Adam with new environment/RNG streams.
Microduck head randomization was corrected earlier. No new mature/multi-seed robot-quality improvement is claimed in this round.
Optional SDK skips are recorded, not treated as coverage. Remote CI was not run. Atomic publication is not an fsync/power-loss durability guarantee.
exploratory_work_excluded_from_final_cla: Earlier raster rectangle-only and intermediate step/guard snapshots were used to choose the final implementation. Final performance claims use candidate-accepted only; long-training computational-path applicability is separately proved.
Initial focused test invocation omitted PYTHONPATH for a child interpreter; explicit source-root reruns and clean full suites passed.

Intermediate candidate-step/candidate-final training and stress cohorts remain local supplemental evidence. Their documented pauses/versions are not counted as final-source endurance or speed results.
Partial-row indexing and palette microprobes guided selection; their timings are not substituted for complete rendering/environment measurements.
